title: The Christian Warrior, See Him Stand
description: The Christian Warrior, See Him Stand in Tonic Solfa to OLD HUNDREDTH, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: James Montgomery wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 362 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Christian Warrior”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to OLD HUNDREDTH; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The Chris-tian war-rior, see him stand In the whole ar-mor of his God; The spi-rit's sword is in his hand; His feet are with the gos-pel shod.

lines: The Christian warrior, see him stand
In the whole armor of his God;
The spirit's sword is in his hand;
His feet are with the gospel shod.
And faith's broad shield before him spread.
From this the alien armies flee;
Till more than conqueror he proves,
Through Christ, who gives him victory.
Thus strong in his Redeemer's strength,
Sin, death and hell he tramples down, —
Fights the good fight; and takes at length,
